metadata.description: Give Claude a video input. /watch downloads, extracts frames, transcribes (local-first via fleet ASR, optional cloud fallback), and hands it all to Claude.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Watch a video (URL or local path). Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts frames with ffmpeg, transcribes via captions or local-first ASR (~/bin/listen) with cloud Whisper fallback.
